title: Manager - Services and Contracts (Procurement)
description:
Key Responsibilities: Strategic Procurement & Sourcing Develop and execute procurement strategies for service categories to achieve cost savings, operational efficiency, and service excellence. Lead end-to-end sourcing activities including RFQ/RFP/RFI preparation, techno-commercial evaluation, negotiation, and contract finalization. Drive supplier consolidation and value engineering initiatives for cost optimization. 
 Contract Management Negotiate and finalize contracts for: Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts (CMC) Manpower and Facility Management Contracts Operation & Maintenance (O&M) Contracts Third-Party Inspection (TPI) Services Civil Works and Infrastructure Contracts Material Handling Equipment (MHE) Rental Contracts Ensure contract compliance, SLA adherence, risk mitigation, and timely renewals. Monitor vendor performance against contractual commitments and KPIs. 
 MRO Procurement Manage procurement of Maintenance, Repair & Operations (MRO) commodities. Ensure uninterrupted availability of consumables, spares, maintenance materials, and engineering items. Optimize inventory and procurement costs through strategic vendor partnerships and sourcing initiatives. 
 Vendor Management Identify, evaluate, onboard, develop, and manage service providers and contractors. Conduct vendor performance reviews and supplier audits. Build long-term relationships with strategic suppliers to ensure quality, service reliability, and competitive pricing. Resolve commercial disputes and performance-related issues. 
 Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Management Manage the complete P2P cycle including requisition processing, purchase order creation, invoice reconciliation, and payment coordination. Ensure procurement transactions comply with company policies and approval matrices. Drive process efficiency and procurement digitalization initiatives. Compliance, Governance & Audits Ensure adherence to procurement policies, statutory requirements, and corporate governance standards. Support and maintain compliance with ISO standards and management systems. Lead procurement compliance reviews and corrective action implementation. Coordinate and support Internal Audits, External Audits, and certification audits. Ensure proper documentation, record management, and audit readiness. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with Engineering, Maintenance, Projects, Operations, Finance, Quality, and User Departments. Provide commercial support for capex and operational procurement requirements. Drive cross-functional alignment for timely execution of procurement projects. Required Experience Proven experience in procurement and contract management of service categories. Strong expertise in negotiating and finalizing AMC, CMC, Manpower, O&M, Third-Party Inspection, Civil Work, and MHE-related contracts. Hands-on experience in procurement of MRO commodities and maintenance-related purchases. Experience in supplier development, vendor performance management, and strategic sourcing. Sound understanding of P2P processes and ERP-based procurement systems, preferably in SAP (MM module). Exposure to ISO standards, compliance frameworks, internal controls, and audit requirements. Strong commercial acumen with cost-saving and value-creation mindset. Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Engineering / Mechanical / Electrical / Industrial Engineering. MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, or Materials Management preferred. Key Skills & Competencies Strategic Sourcing Contract Negotiation & Finalization Vendor Management Service Procurement MRO Procurement Cost Optimization & Cost Reduction Procurement Analytics Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Contract Administration Risk Management ISO Compliance Internal & External Audit Management Stakeholder Management SAP Procurement Modules Commercial Negotiation Supplier Performance Management 
 Preferred Experience 7-12+ years of experience in Procurement/Sourcing with significant exposure to service procurement, contract management, MRO purchasing, compliance management, and audit support in manufacturing, logistics, engineering, industrial, or infrastructure organizations. 
 Key Deliverables (KPIs) Annual procurement cost savings. Contract compliance and SLA adherence. Vendor performance improvement. Procurement cycle time reduction. Audit closure and compliance score. On-time contract renewals. Supplier quality and service improvement. P2P process efficiency and governance compliance.

Key Skills: AMC,Forklift,Annual Maintenance Contract,Material Handling Equipments,Civil Works,Procurement,m,Material handling
